Calendar gating uses Principal's monotonic day_epoch and minute_of_day. Core farming remains playable when this feature is disabled.

state_schema.legacy_policy: Missing optional state defaults safely; malformed present state rejects atomically through Principal save validation.

service_contracts: Village owns consent, jobs and schedules; Principal owns resource receipts; Emergence owns collaboration proposals
Domain ownership is authoritative; cross-system changes use typed idempotent commands, never shadow inventory/NPC/weather/habitat ledgers.

controls.keyboard_mouse: Focus target, inspect preview, choose with arrows/pointer, remappable confirm/cancel.
controls.controller: D-pad/stick focus; shoulders change choice; A confirm, B cancel; accessible explanation.
controls.touch: Tap-to-inspect; large confirmation/cancel controls; long-press for details; no precision drag required.
controls.accessibility: Text alternatives to color/audio, captions, scalable UI and recoverable timers.

resource_accounting.cost: Bounded time/energy or owned inventory only; actual cost and acquisition path must be authored and balanced at implementation.
resource_accounting.invariant: Preview cannot debit; Principal economy applies a single transaction; cancellation refunds only unconsumed reservations.

concepts.original_art_audio: Original stylized-realistic cooperative_agency cues, legible iconography and optional original ambient audio for Village Consensus Noticeboard; provenance manifest and low-spec fallback required.
concepts.save_replay: Deterministic seed, exact command receipts and two-year assembled save/load with day_epoch rollover; no duplicate effects, malformed state fails closed.

acceptance.positive: In real Godot scene, Post proposals, receive reasoned feedback and decide whether to revise or withdraw; verify rule: Only authorized votes count once; dissent remains visible and outcomes noncoercive.
acceptance.adversarial: One NPC cannot cast duplicate ballots
acceptance.integrated: Native assembled-game conservation, invalid-state, duplicate-command and keyboard/controller/touch parity tests before claiming playable.

concepts.engine_portability: Pure state and command schema with Godot adapter only until verified baseline; Unreal/Unity migration requires later approval.
concepts.phase_gate: Phase B design only; Phase C closed until all 220 concepts independently and jointly verified.
